text.title: FreshDrop express slots, iteration 2
text.problem: buyers miss the 2-hour slot and wait a day
text.outcomes: express share of orders from 8% to 15% in 8 weeks
text.users: busy families with 2+ children, weekly orders
text.benefits: an order in 2 hours without planning; 2 orders a week instead of 1
text.solutions: express slot banner, push reminder before the slot, one-tap reorder
text.hypotheses: we believe express share will rise if families get a push reminder, because they forget slots
text.riskiest: families will book express slots at night
text.experiment: push test for 2 weeks on 20% of users; success if express share grows by 5 points
